name: Embedded Evaluators
summary: Independent assessors work inside the lab with deep access, set their own scope and publish what they find.
description: Outside tests of a released model cannot see training runs or internal use. Embedded assessors can.

criteria.label: Deep Access
criteria.description: Assessors get checkpoints, training data, monitoring records and staff.

criteria.label: Permanent
criteria.description: The program has no end date.
